headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox fell short in Toronto, dropping a 1-2 decision to the Blue Jays. Charles McAdoo led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI in the loss. Meanwhile, the New York Mets secured an 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty hitting a home run and driving in four runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Daniel Susac of the San Francisco Giants, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. Other teams with injured players include the Colorado Rockies, Texas Rangers, Los Angeles Angels, New York Mets, Philadelphia Phillies, Tampa Bay Rays, and Milwaukee Brewers.

The Kansas City Royals bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Fall Short in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, failing to secure a win on the road. Charles McAdoo led the Red Sox offense with a home run and an RBI in the loss.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves 8-5**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the team at the plate. Baty hit a home run and drove in four runs, while Brent Suter pitched 3.0 innings of scoreless relief.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win.

top_news.title: **Giants' Daniel Susac Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. The injury occurred on August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as the team looks to strengthen its offense.
